defs.def: the being or spirit that is worshipped and is believed to have created the universe 不与定冠词连用

ex.s: So they have a ＂God’s eye view＂ of activities in their own markets and beyond.
ex.t: 所以它们在自己市场及以外的活动中拥有"上帝视角"。

defs.def: (in some religions) a being or spirit who is believed to have power over a particular part of nature or who is believed to represent a particular quality （某些宗教中主宰某个领域的）神

ex.s: And God knows that I have seen big ones.
Rather, it looks like one of those statues of Greek gods that are regarded as some of the greatest works of art ever produced.
ex.t: 相反，它看起来就像一尊被视为有史以来最伟大艺术作品之一的希腊神像。

ex.t: 天啊！K先生喊道，你接下来又会梦到什么？

ex.s: We call it an epic poem because of its length and because it tells a dramatic story about gods and heroes from long ago.
ex.t: 我们称之为史诗，因为它的长度，也因为它讲述了一个关于远古时代众神和英雄的戏剧性故事。

ex.s: B: Judging from the many fantastical elements in the story, such as gods and goddesses, it's not a historical document.
ex.t: B：从故事中许多幻想元素来看，比如男神和女神，这不是一份历史文献。

defs.def: a person who is loved or admired very much by other people 极受崇拜的人；被崇拜的偶像
something to which too much importance or attention is given 受到过分崇尚（或推崇）的事物
the seats that are high up at the back of a theatre （剧院中的）顶层楼座，最高楼座
